card.name: Spots where "auto" or "autologous" comes next
card.fires_on: Positions in biologic or cell-therapy label text, such as partway through brand names (KIMMTRAK, IMLYGIC) or just before words like circulating, allogeneic or non-transduced, where an "aut-" word could follow. Also scattered punctuation and numerals.

modes.label: Inside biologic brand names
modes.description: Partway through a gene or cell therapy product name.

modes.label: Cell-therapy descriptors
modes.description: On words describing cells or grafts, where autologous or autoimmune could plausibly come next.
modes.example: those with high numbers of<< circulating>> malignant cells

modes.label: Stray punctuation or numbers
modes.description: Odd spots like a slash, period or digit in non-label or numeric text.
modes.example: which used to run over old 386<</>>486 machines

card.writes: It raises words starting with "aut" (autologous, autoimmune, autopsy) and lowers unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It fires where the text may be about to say "autologous" or a similar "auto-" word, mostly in cell and gene therapy labels.
